messages:
maria: @acme-sre We're seeing 403s on SAML login after your IdP cert rotation. Can you confirm you updated the metadata URL and that the signing cert is first?

acme-sre: Yep, noticed at ~10:22 UTC. Logins started failing right after our rotation job. Only affects the prod tenant for now.

maria: Attaching the SAML error from our auth service: 
```
ERROR saml: InvalidSignature: signature verification failed
metadata_signing_cert_thumbprint=sha1:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78
```

alex: That looks like a thumbprint mismatch. Can you paste your metadata URL and entityID so I can fetch it directly?

acme-sre: metadata: https://idp.acme.internal/metadata.xml
entityID: https://acme.okta.com/app/0oa1abcd2EFG3/consumer/saml

jenna: FYI we cache metadata for 5m by default, and there's a short window during rotation where different caches or proxies can serve old metadata. I'll check our metadata-poller logs.

idp_bot: metadata-poller fetched https://idp.acme.internal/metadata.xml 2024-11-12T10:22:34Z status=200 sha256=abcd1234

alex: Can you run on your side: `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha1 -noout -in cert.pem` and paste the fingerprint, and also check if your metadata has multiple KeyDescriptor entries?

acme-sre: Ran it on the cert file we deployed: `SHA1 Fingerprint=AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:EF:12:34:56:78:90:AB:CD:EF:12`

maria: That doesn't line up with the thumbprint our auth service logged — ours starts with 12:34:56... Looks like order or formatting changed.

jenna: Can you paste the KeyDescriptor block from your metadata? Some IdP tooling leaves both the new and old certs in the metadata (sometimes both marked `use="signing"`), and that can confuse verification order in certain XML parsers. We accept any KeyInfo that matches, but intermediate proxies can change which cert appears first.

acme-sre: Here's the relevant snippet from metadata:
```
<KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\">
  <KeyInfo>-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
  MIID...newcert...
  -----END CERTIFICATE-----
</KeyDescriptor>
<KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\">
  <KeyInfo>-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
  MIID...oldcert...
  -----END CERTIFICATE-----
</KeyDescriptor>
```

ryan-oncall: Quick mitigation: we've pushed a short-lived config to accept either thumbprint for that tenant while you complete cleanup. Will revert in 24h. @maria please confirm with the customer.

maria: @acme-sre We've temporarily allowed both thumbprints; you should be able to login now. Can you confirm and we'll schedule a poller refresh and rotation checklist to avoid this window next time?

acme-sre: Confirmed — logins working again. We'll remove the old cert from metadata and force a cache-busting header on the URL. We'll also audit our rotation job to ensure only the new signing cert remains. Please keep the temporary accept window short.

jenna: Action items: (1) add a poller path that forces a fetch on thumbprint mismatch, (2) add an alert when fetched metadata thumbprint != cached thumbprint, (3) document the dual-KeyDescriptor gotcha and recommend ordering the active signing key first. Assigning (1) & (2) to alex and me.

alex: Ack — I'll open a GH issue and link this thread. Also will add a small jitter to the poller to avoid thundering herd on mass rotations. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll close the support loop with the customer and keep the temp accept until 10:30 UTC tomorrow unless you request an extension. Thanks everyone!
